label: Dei Filius attributes: the classical attributes defined as nineteen typed or primitive conjuncts
definition: DeiFiliusAttributes σ InAct GoodIn InPotency CausesIn esse MoreIn ComponentOf Composite MatterForm Infinite Eternal HasIntellect HasWill P D g holds when g has every attribute that Vatican I, Dei Filius ch. 1 (DS 3001, with goodness from DS 3002) confesses of God, each as a typed predicate or an explicitly identified primitive: one (IsTheOneGod σ.IsGod, DEF-ONE-GOD); living (primitive Lives, DEF-LIVING); creator of heaven and earth (IsCreatorOfAll: g causes the being of everything else in act as to being); lord (primitive IsLord); almighty (IsAlmighty: g can do every consistent task, in the Power vocabulary DEF-ACTIVE-POWER-TASK-VOCABULARY); eternal (ETERNAL_1); immense (primitive Immense); incomprehensible (primitive Incomprehensible); infinite in intellect, will and every perfection, read as HasIntellect, HasWill, IsPerfect and Infinite (HAS_INTELLECT_1, HAS_WILL_1, PERFECT_2, INFINITE_1); altogether simple (IsSimple, SIMPLE_4); unchangeable (IsImmutable, IMMUTABLE_1); spiritual (IsSpiritual: not composed of matter and form); really distinct from the world (RemoteFromAll, DEF-REMOTE-FROM-ALL); most blessed (primitive MostBlessed); exalted above all (IsMaximumIn InAct MoreIn esse, DEF-MAXIME-ENS); supremely good (IsSupremelyGood, DEF-SUPREMELY-GOOD). The nine stage-two predicates are among the fields (nineOfDeiFilius).
note: Analyst reading of the attribute list recorded in claim VATICAN-I-DEI-FILIUS-CH1-ONE-TRUE-LIVING-GOD; the claim motivates the list and states no bridge. Weakenings, each stated so that no stronger reading is attributed: 'creator' omits creation from nothing, freedom and a beginning; 'infinite in intellect and will' is read as the conjunction of having intellect, having will and being infinite (the infinity of intellect and will as such is not typed); 'substance' is not typed (only immateriality); 'distinct from the world' is read as entering into the composition of nothing, without numerical non-identity with the world as a whole (no world term) or distinctness in essence; 'exalted above all' is read as not exceeded in being, not as exceeding everything else, and 'ineffably' and 'above all that can be conceived' are not typed. 'True' (verus) is not a field: it is the predicate σ.IsGod (GOD_4) of which the attributes are confessed. Defined in place of the primitive skeleton field HasClassicalAttributes, which stays primitive; FieldFromDeiFilius is the open one-way interpretation linking the two. Five conjuncts are primitives with stated meanings and open bridges (see the Primitives structure).
